name: Allegion
outlook:
What Allegion says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue growthThe company is raising its full-year 2026 reported revenue growth outlook to a range of 9.5% to 10.5% and is raising its organic growth outlook to a range of 5.0% to 6.0%, after excluding the expected impacts of acquisitions, divestitures and foreign currency movements.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted and reported earnings per shareThe company is raising the outlook for full-year 2026 adjusted EPS to be in the range of $9.05 to $9.10. The company is updating the outlook for full-year 2026 reported EPS and expects it to be in the range of $8.35 to $8.40.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted effective tax rateThe outlook continues to assume a full-year adjusted effective tax rate of approximately 18% to 19%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 22, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
